stories.h: Police chase ends in deadly Spanaway crash, SR 7 closed
stories.s: A fleeing suspect slammed into another car at high speed on Pacific Avenue (SR 7) Sunday night, killing a man. A suspect is in custody; SR 7 near 163rd-166th St. S. was shut for hours.

coming.h: Tacoma council expected to adopt 2027-28 budget
coming.s: After closing a $40 million gap, including cutting the HOPE team and restoring five community service officers, the council plans to adopt the budget at this week's meeting.
